Preg, AAA, trauma, malig, pancreas/spleen, ulcer
Lt lat decubitus -> percuss tympany/dullness, mark borders
Supine, pt edge of hand on abd (poss 2 hands), My hand on both sides  -> sharp strike one side
Stroke, pinch all areas of A. abdomen
***If pt ticklish, use pt’s finger to do*****
Pt on tip toes & drop on heels OR hit heels of pt
2 hands 90’ -> gentle & deep press -> fast w/draw hand
*** “I am going to press &remove my hand fast (demonstrate on arm -let me know if it hurts more when i press, lift, or not at all”*****
Active: supine, legs flat -> push Rt leg up against you
Passive: Lt lat decubitus -> stabilize hip, grab knee, stretch leg back
Pt supine, knee @ 90’ -> support ankle, turn knee in (ankle out)
(+) = Lt shoulder pain -> blood/irritants in underside of diaphragm/peritoneal cavity
